rationale: Calculated required reactive power to correct voltage violations: at 0.94 pu inject 14.29 kvar (0.1429 fraction) to reach 0.95 pu, at 1.07 pu absorb 28.57 kvar (-0.2857 fraction) to reach 1.05 pu. Middle point at 1.0 pu with zero reactive power minimizes control effort at nominal voltage. All values respect inverter capability of 80 kvar and maintain monotonic non-increasing q_fraction with increasing voltage.
